snippet.title: Saint of Chains - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Saint of Chains, a first-person psychological survival horror game developed by MystiveDev. Players will take on 2000s-inspired monsters across this retro experience, centered on a rescue mission. Solve puzzles, make good use of weaponry, and find the missing family before all hope is lost. Saint of Chains is available now for PC (Steam).
